decisive_items: diffuse, generalized hyperintensity of the supratentorial white matter on T2/FLAIR sequences
response.rationale: R6 uniquely combines the core motor (gait disturbance, rigid-akinetic syndrome) and the distinctive MRI finding (diffuse white matter hyperintensity), which are the most specific and diagnostic features. R1 covers motor and cognitive but lacks the MRI, while R2 covers gait and MRI but not the rigid-akinetic syndrome. R6 is the only candidate that aligns with the full motor-imaging pattern.

rejected.why: Lacks the rigid-akinetic syndrome and the MRI finding is not typical for NPH; also has a noted contradiction regarding contrast enhancement.
Only covers cognitive/psychiatric symptoms, missing the motor and imaging features.
Covers gait and rigid-akinetic but lacks the MRI finding and cognitive aspects; less specific than R6.
Append-only completion of R2, not a distinct diagnosis; inherits R2's weaknesses.
